# no-multiple-space-blockquote

- ID: `MD027`
- Category: Blockquotes
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `blockquote`, `whitespace`, `indentation`

Outside code and list item text, at most one space follows a blockquote's \>.

## Why

Extra spaces after \> make the quote harder to read. At the start of a block,
five spaces after \> make an indented code block.

## Options

Set them under `rules.no-multiple-space-blockquote.options`.

- `list_items` (`boolean`, default `true`): Check the space after \> in front of
  list items too.

## Fix

The fix deletes the extra spaces. gomdlint reports fence lines and HTML lines
inside the quote without a fix. The same goes for some list items, such as one
that holds a second paragraph, a code block or a quote. gomdlint may report a
finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one character in
brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line,
because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document with raw HTML
other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint reports every
finding without a fix.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

>  Back up your files before you upgrade.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:3 Multiple spaces (2) after blockquote symbol
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

> Back up your files before you upgrade.
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  no-multiple-space-blockquote:
    options:
      list_items: true
```

Under `rules`, `no-multiple-space-blockquote: false` turns the rule off and
`no-multiple-space-blockquote: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-multiple-space-blockquote` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-multiple-space-blockquote -->
```
